compound: Putrescine dihydrochloride; generic putrescine only where source form unresolved

disposition.route: experimental nonmalignant reproductive-function reserve, with separate access-limited aneuploidy lead
disposition.positive: Reduced embryo resorption in two older-mouse strains and greater blastocyst cell numbers; observed aggregate live-pup increase.
disposition.limit: No BUB1B/BubR1 response, MVA model or isolated oocyte mechanism demonstrated; 2013 aneuploidy source remains abstract-level.
disposition.competitive_comparison: The directly administered common-molecule preparation has meaningful noncancer in-vivo outcomes and deserves retention beside provisional niacin/apitegromab hypotheses, which also lack demonstrated MVA benefit. This does not rank it as an established MVA treatment.

current_reproductive_cohort_aneuploidy.basis: Discussion references prior2013 finding and unpublished karyotypes rather than providing concurrent karyotype outcomes.

design_limits: Multiple implantation sites per mother; reported Fisher test does not model maternal clustering.
Random allocation and blinded classification not stated in read Methods.
Cohort/batch replication and donor-level blastocyst data unavailable without supplementary tables.
Males co-exposed in drinking-water mating protocol and rotated between later experiments; isolated oocyte mechanism not established.
No IVF/embryo transfer performed in2015; authors explicitly identify those as needed to exclude male/uterine contributions.
Oral intake not quantified per mouse; subjective no-noticeable-consumption-change observation is not a measured exposure control.
Within-study two-strain outcomes are not independent-laboratory replication.
Native images, numerical point distributions and supplement data unavailable; reported values not independently reproduced.

safety.observed: Small young-mouse breeding groups and offspring breeding observations reported normal pups and fertility.
